title: Blood and Steel
storySoFar: Vic Stone's Four Saddles empire fractures under paranoia as the Blue-Collar Brotherhood rises. Gunner Gates has openly confessed to being the mystery attacker—blackballed years ago—and will fight alongside the people at Steel & Scripture. Silver Streak claws toward his #1 contendership ladder match, defying Stone's obsession to unmask him. Colt Brady's blood war with Rex Creed escalates toward a Falls Count Anywhere match at the PPV. Hank Luther hunts Blackthorn Blake, the TV Championship on the line in a chain match next week. Jenny Crossfire earns Georgia Storm's mentorship in a non-title bout, positioning her as the next Women's challenger. Blackjack Torres plays both sides as a dangerous tweener wildcard. At Steel & Scripture: Ladder Match for #1 Contendership (Streak, Brady, Gates, Gray), Falls Count Anywhere (Brady vs Creed), Chain Match (Luther vs Blake), No-DQ Women's Match (Crossfire vs Moon), Battle Royal (crown rising contender), and Women's Title defense (Storm vs Magnolia).

segments.title: Segment One: The Miner's Vow

lines: You hear me, Creed? I'm coming for you in that Falls Count Anywhere match!
Every lie you preached, every soul you swindled—it ends when I plant you on the concrete!
This ain't just wrestling. This is blood debt, and blood debts are paid in FULL!

segments.recap: Colt Brady cuts a fiery promo vowing to end Rex Creed's life of lies at Steel & Scripture in a Falls Count Anywhere Match.

segments.title: Segment Two: Qualifying Gauntlet for the Ladder Match

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Silver Streak exploding early—he KNOWS what's at stake at Steel & Scripture!

moments.speaker: marcus_gray
moments.line: You can't win against the Saddles, masked fool!

moments.speaker: color
moments.line: Gray's precision is no match for Streak's pure instinct tonight.

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Silver Streak has locked in his spot in the Ladder Match! He's ONE match away from facing Vic Stone for the World Title!

lines: Enjoy your qualification, Streak. At Steel & Scripture, you'll climb that ladder knowing full well—I will be WATCHING.
And when you fail, I'll unmask you in front of the whole world.

segments.recap: Silver Streak faces a gauntlet of Four Saddles challengers to earn his spot in the Steel & Scripture Ladder Match for the #1 Contendership; he emerges victorious, securing his path to Vic Stone.

segments.title: Segment Three: The Reverend's Interview

exchange.speaker: reverend_tate_chambers
exchange.text: Rex, Colt Brady is coming for blood at Steel & Scripture. Are you prepared for a Falls Count Anywhere Match?

exchange.speaker: rex_creed
exchange.text: Prepared? Boy, I've been PREACHING my whole life. Brady's just another lost soul I'll baptize in PAIN!

exchange.speaker: reverend_tate_chambers
exchange.text: Some say Reverend Doc Darkside has been feeding you darker counsel lately. Is the Flock fracturing?

exchange.speaker: rex_creed
exchange.text: The Flock answers to GOD and to REX CREED. Not to Stone. Not to Gray. And certainly not to some coal miner!

exchange.speaker: rev_darkside
exchange.text: The Reverend has spoken. Now leave us.

segments.recap: Reverend Tate Chambers interviews Rex Creed backstage about his upcoming Falls Count Anywhere Match with Colt Brady; Creed vows victory while Doc Darkside looms in the shadows, and the interview ends with Creed storming off in anger.

segments.title: Segment Four: Jenny Earns Her Shot

moments.speaker: jenny_crossfire
moments.line: I'm gonna prove I belong in that title picture, Georgia!

moments.speaker: color
moments.line: Storm's technical wrestling is on full display—but Crossfire's tenacity is keeping her in this fight.

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Storm measures Crossfire for the Southern Comfort—but Jenny escapes and fires back!

moments.speaker: georgia_storm
moments.line: You fought with honor tonight, Jenny. At Steel & Scripture, you'll stand in MY corner against that fraud Crystal Moon.

segments.recap: In a non-title match, Jenny Crossfire challenges Women's Champion Georgia Storm; though Jenny falls short, she earns Georgia's respect, leading to a post-match embrace and a vow that Jenny will be her enforcer at Steel & Scripture against Crystal Moon.

segments.title: Segment Five: Luther's Warning

exchange.speaker: hank_luther
exchange.text: Blake, I recognize you. I know who you are. And at Steel & Scripture, the law catches up to criminals in a steel chain.

exchange.speaker: blackthorn_blake
exchange.text: Law? HAHAHAHA! There's no law in the STW, old man. Only the strong and the BROKEN!

exchange.speaker: hank_luther
exchange.text: Then I'll break you myself. The chain won't be long enough to save you.

beats.text: Dusty Mason with the SAVE! Blake scrambles up the ramp as the Roundhouse stands tall with his brother Luther!
beats.speaker: pbp

segments.recap: Hank Luther confronts Blackthorn Blake on the ramp, warning him that justice is coming in a Chain Match at Steel & Scripture; Blake responds with mockery and a crack of his riding crop, escalating the feud.

segments.title: Segment Six: The Reckoning Confirmed

lines: I was blackballed. Forgotten. But I never forgot who did it—VIC STONE.
At Steel & Scripture, I'm climbing that ladder with Silver Streak, Colt Brady, and we're DETONATING this empire!
The house doesn't always win, Stone. When you show your hand, the cards fall where the PEOPLE decide!

beats.text: The Blue-Collar Brotherhood is COMPLETE! Colt Brady, Hank Luther, Dusty Mason, Gunner Gates, and Cornerman Ed stand UNIFIED against the Four Saddles!
beats.speaker: pbp

lines: How touching. The broken toys gather for one last hurrah.
At Steel & Scripture, I will watch as each and every one of you FAILS. And when the dust settles, the Four Saddles will reign ETERNAL.

stateChanges.reason: Gunner Gates reveals his blackballing by Vic Stone years ago and commits fully to the Blue-Collar Brotherhood's war against the Four Saddles.

stateChanges.text: STEEL & SCRIPTURE PPV CARD LOCKED IN: (1) Ladder Match for #1 Contendership: Silver Streak vs Colt Brady vs Gunner Gates vs Marcus Gray; (2) Falls Count Anywhere: Colt Brady vs Rex Creed (w/ Rev Darkside); (3) Chain Match, TV Title on the line: Hank Luther (c) vs Blackthorn Blake; (4) No-DQ Match: Jenny Crossfire vs Crystal Moon; (5) Battle Royal (crown rising contender): TBD field; (6) STW Women's Championship: Georgia Storm (c) vs Madame Magnolia. Next week is the go-home show for the PPV blow-off.

Rex Creed's Flock (Creed + Rev Darkside) shows visible fracture from the Four Saddles under Vic Stone's paranoia and control. Creed is operating increasingly independently, foreshadowing his eventual downfall in the 3-on-3 match at Dixie Thunderdome.

Georgia Storm has formalized Jenny Crossfire as her special guest enforcer at Steel & Scripture against Crystal Moon. Jenny's grit and honor have earned the Women's Champion's respect, positioning her as the next challenger after Moon is exposed as a fraud.

segments.recap: Gunner Gates formally aligns with the Blue-Collar Brotherhood before a roaring crowd, vowing to stand alongside Colt Brady, Hank Luther, and Dusty Mason at Steel & Scripture in the war against the Four Saddles.
